'''Force-stick''', also known as achieving '''Immovability''', was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used in to bind oneself to a surface, to avoid falling off when subjected to pressures and forces, such as impacts or gravity.

==Description==
A Force user, such as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], could use this power to halt a fall by binding to a surface and sticking to it.<ref name="DN2" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was forced to use this power during his battle with [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], drawing on the Force to root himself in place and not be yanked away by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who he was connected to by a rope, instead, Kenobi was the one who tore off Fett's jetpack by holding tightly.<ref name="AotC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' {{C|novelization}}]]</ref>
